one_line: Chaulukya king of Gujarat overseeing the Od master-builders of Sahasralinga Talav at Patan.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s to early 40s, medium-tall, lean but well-built with a disciplined warrior’s frame.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp nose, medium-brown wheatish complexion, finely trimmed moustache and short beard framing the jaw, expressive dark eyes with a calm but intense gaze, default expression a composed, thoughtful half-smile showing quiet confidence and curiosity.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair pulled back into a neatly bound topknot at the crown, sides smoothed back; a simple narrow gold circlet with a small central lotus motif rests across the forehead, and a light off-white cotton patka is tied around the base of the topknot like a band.
appearance.costume: He wears a long-sleeved knee-length angarkha-style tunic in rich deep red cotton with fine golden-yellow woven borders along the neckline, front overlap and sleeve cuffs, wrapped right-over-left and tied at the side with a hidden cord; over this is a sleeveless, slightly padded dark indigo-blue cotton vest with subtle vertical quilting lines suggesting light armour, its edges trimmed in narrow gold piping; a broad cream-coloured cotton sash (kamarbandh) wraps twice around his waist with the loose end tucked at his left hip; his lower garment is a full, ankle-length dhoti-style wrap in muted cream with a thin maroon border, pleated neatly in front and drawn up for easy movement; he wears simple brown leather sandals with toe loops; jewellery is restrained but royal—medium-thick gold hoop earrings, a single flat gold necklace with three small pendants resting on the upper chest, and two plain gold bangles on each wrist; overall the fabrics look practical and breathable, suited to a royal inspecting hydraulic works rather than seated in full court regalia.
appearance.signature: A rolled palm-leaf manuscript map case in dark brown leather, slung diagonally across his chest on a strap and usually held in his left hand, its capped ends decorated with simple brass rings, symbolising royal plans for canals, ghats and the Sahasralinga Talav layout.

ref_desc: Jayasimha Siddharaja is a medium-tall, wheatish-complexioned Chaulukya king with a trimmed moustache and beard, black hair in a topknot with a gold circlet, wearing a deep red angarkha, indigo quilted vest, cream dhoti and sash, simple gold jewellery, brown sandals, and carrying a diagonal-strap dark leather palm-leaf map case with brass ends in a palette of deep red, indigo, cream, golden yellow and brown leather.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Jayasimha Siddharaja as a dignified 12th-century Chaulukya king of Gujarat, medium-tall and lean, with an oval wheatish-brown face, sharp nose, trimmed moustache and short beard, and focused dark eyes, his thick black hair pulled into a neat topknot at the crown held by a narrow gold circlet with a small central lotus and a light off-white band tied around the base; show him in a long-sleeved knee-length deep red cotton angarkha wrapped right over left with fine golden-yellow borders at the neckline, front overlap and cuffs, over which he wears a sleeveless dark indigo-blue lightly quilted vest edged with narrow gold piping, a broad cream cotton waist sash wrapped twice and tucked at the left hip, and an ankle-length cream dhoti-style wrap with a thin maroon border, pleated cleanly, paired with simple brown leather sandals; add restrained royal jewellery—medium-thick gold hoop earrings, a single flat gold necklace with three small pendants, and two plain gold bangles per wrist—keeping the overall look practical for overseeing hydraulic works; his signature prop is a rolled dark brown leather palm-leaf manuscript map case with brass-capped ends slung diagonally across his chest on a strap and often held in his left hand, and the colour palette is dominated by deep red, indigo blue, cream, golden yellow and brown leather; present him from multiple angles and poses but always with this same face, topknot and circlet, outfit, jewellery and map case so the design can be redrawn consistently.
